name: Nio
source:
An axolotl of science, sarcasm and action. This guy's pretty much the only dude who realizes something is off and is trying to set things right.

[spoiler]ALLEN's pragmatic side and the manifestation of his curiosity and ambitiousness.[/spoiler]
